name: Nav
usage: The main navigation in the sidebar of an application; the sections of a settings area

props.name: items
props.description: Items and groups, in order. Items outside groups come first, usually (Home, Inbox).

props.name: value
props.description:
Key of the current page: the item gets the selected style and `aria-current="page"`. `null` when no item is
current.

props.name: onSelect
props.description:
Called with the key when an item is chosen. On items with `href`, plain clicks call it instead of following the
link (for client-side routing); clicks with a modifier key or the middle button open the link as usual.
Without `onSelect`, links are followed by the browser.

props.name: collapsed
props.description:
Icons only: the labels show in tooltips on the right and remain the accessible names; group headings are
hidden. Inside the sidebar of AppShell, it follows the sidebar when omitted.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark; "Main" when omitted. Give each Nav of a page its own name.

types.name: NavItem
types.summary: An item of Nav: a page of the application.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Unique key, passed to `onSelect` and compared with `value`.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Text of the item; also the tooltip and the accessible name when Nav is collapsed.

fields.name: icon
fields.description:
Icon: a name, or an icon component such as Lucide's `House`. Give every item an icon, or none: a collapsed Nav
shows a dot for items without one.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Count shown at the end (CountBadge); nothing is shown when it is 0 or omitted.

fields.name: countTone
fields.description: Tone of the count: `accent` for unread items and to-dos, `neutral` for plain counts.

fields.name: href
fields.description:
Address of the page: the item is a real link (`<a href>`), so it can be opened in a new tab. Without it, the
item is a button that calls `onSelect`.

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: Disabled: shown faded, cannot be focused or chosen.

types.name: NavGroup
types.summary: A group of Nav items with a heading.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Marks the entry as a group.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Unique key of the group; the label is used when omitted.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Heading of the group; hidden when Nav is collapsed (screen readers still read it).

fields.name: items
fields.description: Items of the group (groups are not nested).

types.name: IconName
types.summary:
Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`. Props that take an
icon also accept an icon component instead of a name (see IconComponent).

types.name: IconComponent
types.summary:
An icon component, such as Lucide's `Plus` (`import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'`), accepted wherever an icon name
is: `<Button icon={Plus}>`, `<Icon icon={Plus} />`, menu items and so on. Names (`icon="plus"`) are convenient
and work in data such as menu configurations, but cover only the registered icons (`iconNames`); a component can
be any Lucide icon, or an SVG of your own. Both are drawn with the same size, stroke width and `tone`.

types.name: IconComponentProps
types.summary:
Props that Icon passes to an icon component. Lucide icons (`import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'`) accept them; a
component of another icon set, or an SVG of your own, works too if it accepts them, or passes them on to its
`<svg>`.

fields.name: strokeWidth
fields.description:
Stroke width in the units of a 24 × 24 view box, already scaled for `size`: the line is 1.75 px wide on screen
by default, whatever the size.

fields.name: color
fields.description:
Stroke color: `currentColor` (the text color) or a semantic color variable, such as
`var(--vl-color-danger)`.

fields.name: aria-hidden
fields.description: `true` for a decorative icon (hidden from screen readers).

fields.name: aria-label
fields.description: Accessible name of a meaningful icon.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Items with icons and counts, then a group with a heading. `value` is the key of the current page and
`onSelect` receives the key of the chosen item. In an application, Nav goes in the `sidebar` of AppShell.

examples.name: Links
examples.title: Links
examples.description:
Items with `href` are real links, so they can be opened in a new tab. With `onSelect`, plain clicks call it
instead of following the link: pass your router's navigation there.

examples.name: Collapsed
examples.title: Collapsed
examples.description:
`collapsed` shows icons only; the labels appear in tooltips and stay the accessible names. Inside AppShell,
Nav follows the sidebar and needs no `collapsed` of its own.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.title: Disabled item
examples.description: A disabled item is faded and skipped by `Tab` and the arrow keys.
